fusions.name: Encrusting Colony
fusions.desc: A burst that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles and leaves them [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on each target spread to every enemy within 4 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Razor Polyps
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 7 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 4 seconds. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Brood Nursery
fusions.desc: Raises a reef around you for 8 seconds that restores 3 health a second to you and every ally within 4 tiles. Every ally within 5.5 tiles makes it 10% stronger, up to 4 allies.

fusions.name: Cell on Cell
fusions.desc: Every time you use an ability, a stack builds on you, up to 10. At 10 they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
